title: Worker pool with a Stop that leaves nothing running
task: Implement `pool.Pool` with `New(workers int, handle func(Job))`, `Submit(job Job) error`, and `Stop()`. Stop waits for every submitted job to finish and then returns, after which no goroutine of the pool is still running; Submit after Stop is an error. The tests must prove all N submitted jobs ran and that Stop returns, without sleeps or timing assumptions.
